caption: One block is lifted out of a box of magnetic building blocks, and the others cling to it in a hanging chain.

sa.check: A box of magnetic building blocks.
One block is lifted out of the box.
Other blocks come up with it, hanging from it in a chain.
The chain hangs below the lifted block, one block from another.
The lift comes first and the chain forms as the block rises.

pc.expect: As the lifted block rises, blocks in contact with it come up too, each held to the one above, forming a chain that hangs from the lifted block.
pc.fail: The top block comes up alone while the blocks that were touching it stay behind; or blocks rise alongside it with gaps between them; or blocks leave the box before the top block has moved.

pc.expect: The chain hangs downward from the lifted block; a block that lets go falls down into the box or onto the table.
pc.fail: Blocks stand up above the lifted block or trail off sideways in the air; or a block that comes loose floats or drifts upward; or a detached block hangs in the air below the chain without touching it.

pc.expect: The hanging chain swings beneath the lifted block as it moves and settles below it.
pc.fail: The chain stays fixed in the air where it was while the top block moves on; or the chain swings with nothing touching it while the top block is held still; or the lower blocks move before the top block does.

pc.expect: The blocks left in the box stay still as the chain lifts away; the box stays where it is.
pc.fail: Blocks left in the box shift or rearrange as the chain rises with nothing touching them; or the box slides across the table; or a chained block spins on its own while the rest of the chain hangs still.

pc.expect: The blocks keep their number and shapes; those in the chain plus those in the box are the blocks that were in the box; no block passes through another or through the box.
pc.fail: Blocks appear in the chain that were not in the box; or blocks vanish in mid-air; or two blocks merge into one longer piece; or a block passes through the box's wall.

pc.expect: The blocks keep their colours; the box and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: A block changes colour as it rises; or the box changes pattern; or the table surface changes.
